technical_and_design_decisions: Use existing Spring Cloud Stream module structure for sink and processor modules.
Port modules from Spring XD by extracting source code, adapting to Spring Cloud Stream binder APIs, and writing new unit tests.
Implement Job DSL using Spring Cloud Task and Spring Batch patterns, providing a Groovy-based DSL similar to Spring XD.
Integrate Flink processor via Spring Cloud Stream Flink binder or custom adapter.
Use Maven for build and dependency management, following standard Spring project conventions.
Write comprehensive unit and integration tests using Spring Boot test framework.
Maintain backward compatibility with existing Spring Cloud Stream APIs.
assumptions: The s-c-s repo refers to Spring Cloud Stream.
The XD repo refers to Spring XD, with existing module source code available for porting.
Module ports are straightforward adaptations of existing XD sink modules to Spring Cloud Stream's sink interface.
The Kinesis module requires integration with AWS Kinesis; assumes availability of AWS SDK and local testing via mock.
Job DSL implementation will be based on an existing Spring XD DSL parser but re-implemented for Spring Cloud Task.
Flink processor assumes a basic Flink streaming job integration; no complex ML abstractions are implemented, only the adapter.
Developer is proficient in Spring Framework, Spring Cloud Stream, and related technologies.
Effort estimates assume no major unforeseen technical challenges and a stable development environment.

activities.activity_name: Setup development environment and project structure
activities.activity_description: Initialize repository, configure Maven parent pom, set up modules for each new component, add dependencies, and configure CI.
Port or create a new Spring Cloud Stream sink module for Amazon Kinesis, including configuration, message producer, serialization, and unit tests.
Port the Log sink module from XD, providing a simple log output sink. Includes configuration properties, log message formatting, and tests.
Design and implement a Groovy-based DSL for defining and orchestrating jobs (batch workflows). Integrate with Spring Cloud Task and Spring Batch. Includes parser, job launcher, and sample tests.
Port the field-value-counter module from XD, implementing a counter sink that counts field values. Includes storing counts (e.g., in Redis or in-memory) and tests.
Port the aggregate-counter module from XD, implementing a counter that aggregates counts over time windows. Includes configuration, aggregation logic, and tests.
Port the gauge module from XD, implementing a simple gauge (latest value) sink. Includes storage and retrieval, and tests.
Port the rich-gauge module from XD, extending gauge with additional statistics (mean, variance, etc.). Includes calculation logic and tests.
Create a Spring Cloud Stream processor that integrates with Apache Flink for stream processing. Includes adapter for Flink DataStream API, configuration, and sample tests.
Run end-to-end integration tests for all modules, fix issues, ensure compatibility with Spring Cloud Stream core, and perform performance sanity checks.
Write or update README files, module documentation, configuration reference, and usage examples for each new component.
Attend code review sessions, address feedback, refactor code if necessary, and finalize the increment for release.
